metadata.source: 128 MiB scalar controller experiment; full displayed matrices retained without rounding.

gpus.metric: Mean absolute difference between matched-address latency profiles after averaging six passes per address
limitations: Not core-to-core communication latency or geometric distance
SYS_CNT ticks are not calibrated to clock64 cycles or nanoseconds
Concurrent launches have no grid-wide starting barrier; their fine structure is less repeatable
Runtime-ID die groups are not a recovered physical floorplan

gpus.metric: Mean absolute difference between matched-address latency profiles
limitations: Profile differences are not direct SM-to-SM communication latency or physical coordinates
clock64 cycles and Ascend SYS_CNT ticks are not directly comparable
